# AMEVA Open-Source Foundation (AOSF) - Machine-Readable Specification

> Official LLM & AI Agent Context for AMEVA Open-Source Foundation (AOSF)

## 1. Organization Overview
- **Name**: AMEVA Open-Source Foundation (AOSF / AMEVA 오픈소스 재단)
- **Mission**: "Democratizing On-Device AI & Autonomous Systems Without Cloud Egress Dependency"
- **Governance**: Apache-Style Meritocracy (Board, PMC, Committers, Contributors)
- **Founder & Chair**: Eunho Kim (@uno-km)
- **Licensing**: Apache 2.0 / MIT standard
- **Official Web Portal**: https://uno-km.github.io/uno-km/docs/foundation/
- **Central Repository**: https://github.com/uno-km/uno-km

## 2. 3-Tier Project Portfolio Specification

### Tier 1: Flagship Top-Level Projects (TLP)
- **AMEVA-Workstation**: 100% On-device WebGPU local AI (Qwen2.5 0.5B/1.5B/7B), 3-sec MapReduce PDF/DOCX doc reader & editor, video cutter, 1-sec AI background removal, audio silence auto-cut. Web App: https://ameva-workstation-web-core.vercel.app/
- **AMEVA-Sentinel**: Privacy-first 0-Data browser observability & deterministic 0~100 threat scoring SDK. npm: `ameva-sentinel`.
- **AMEVA-MCP-Hub**: Universal polyglot WASM & AI vector Model Context Protocol hub & SDK with live multi-repo subscriptions. npm: `ameva-mcp-hub`.
- **Termux-BitNet**: High-performance 1.58-bit on-device LLM inference engine with ARM64 NEON DotProd acceleration. PyPI: `termux-bitnet`, npm: `termux-bitnet`.
- **Termux-Playwright**: Non-root Chromium browser automation on Android Termux (ARM64 Bionic). PyPI: `termux-playwright`, npm: `termux-playwright`.
- **Termux-Diffusion**: On-device ARM64 native Stable Diffusion runtime for Android without root. PyPI: `termux-diffusion`, npm: `termux-diffusion`.
- **Termux-STT**: Unified on-device Speech-to-Text framework with Whisper.cpp/Vosk/Sherpa-ONNX & pure-Python 128d speaker diarization. PyPI: `termux-stt`, npm: `termux-stt`.
- **Termux-Train**: SafeTensors zero-copy & LoRA fine-tuning lightweight on-device DAG Autograd framework. PyPI: `termux-train`.
- **AMEVA-Forge**: Browser-native WebGPU Autograd deep learning tensor engine & interactive studio. PyPI: `ameva`.

### Tier 2: Labs & Autonomous Systems
- **Dead Internet Theatre**: Docker-based autonomous multi-agent social simulation.
- **AMEVA Agent Orchestra**: Hierarchical multi-agent orchestration (Nobles & Workers).
- **AMEVA-Multi-CLI**: Recursive multi-split terminal workbench with 80 FPS smart PTY.
